seed_rule: SHA256 of the UTF-8 literal dosei-secondary-prospective-v2, chosen independently of authentic outcomes
missing_support: Full-person MAE/calibration/paired intervals undefined if any biological person has no evaluable original assessment. Category recall is explicitly limited to persons with that category and lists all unsupported persons.

rationale.hard_category: The lower probability median minimizes expected absolute ordinal loss, with an explicit deterministic tie convention. Recall uses the same decision rather than changing it by metric.
rationale.aggregation: Equal-person weighting follows the primary estimand and prevents dense clinical assessment schedules from dominating the result.
rationale.calibration: Fixed five equal-width bins provide a simple prospective descriptive reliability partition. Counts are always shown; ECE depends on binning and does not certify calibration.
rationale.bootstrap: Joint biological-person resampling keeps repeated recordings/assessments together and preserves arm pairing. Percentile intervals are transparent conditional summaries of fixed predictions; no refitting or empirical coverage claim.

alternatives.hard_category: lowest_probability_mode is supported only when explicitly selected in a separately frozen policy; it optimizes a different loss.
alternatives.calibration: Finer bins, adaptive bins and alternate calibration functionals require a distinct prospective definition; no outcome-driven switch is supplied.
alternatives.uncertainty: BCa, hierarchical or retraining-aware intervals require a distinct validated protocol; none is implied by these conditional percentile intervals.

identity_operands_still_required: External policy, before-outcome and same-input/training receipt hashes
ordinal_distance_unit: Unit steps on released collapsed category indices1..5, not equal clinical-severity distance
conditional_uncertainty_scope: Fixed cross-fitted predictions can share overlapping training folds. These are descriptive conditional intervals, not validated new-patient/generalization confidence intervals or training/refitting uncertainty.
recommended_initial_qualification_compar: Audited causal spectral/entropy ordinal model on identical packet and training evidence
Train-only random forest on the same audited causal packet/features
comparator_qualification: Exact models/features and competence remain independent scientific gates; no qualified reference is supplied here.
